PRECAPTURE.description: Preview Capture (PRECAPTURE). Exports a preview capture of the current model view; the fields are driven by the requested view type.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Output Path. Destination file path where the capture is exported.

VIEW_TYPE.description: View Type. Selects which preview capture view is produced. Only FIBR is handled; any other value is rejected. Case-insensitive.

OPTION.description: Precapture Option. Options consumed together with the view type; ID is used as the capture key.
